name: Sandals Negril
tagline: Luxury adults-only all-inclusive on Negril's best stretch of beach

contact.address: Norman Manley Blvd, Negril, Westmoreland Parish, Jamaica

description: Sandals Negril sits on what many consider the finest stretch of Seven Mile Beach — a 2,000-ft private white sand beach that consistently earns the highest beach ratings of any Negril all-inclusive. The Sandals brand promise delivers premium dining, butler suites, multiple pools, and the famously attentive Sandals service culture. Not a lifestyle/nudist resort — a premium romantic adults-only all-inclusive for couples who want luxury and the Caribbean's finest beach.
highlights: 2,000-ft private stretch of Seven Mile Beach — consistently rated top beach
Premium Sandals brand: butler service, top-shelf spirits, gourmet dining
7 pools including swim-up suites and overwater bungalows
Multiple restaurants included — Japanese, Italian, Caribbean, and more
WeddingMoon specialist — ceremony, reception, and honeymoon packages
Scuba diving included (unique to Sandals among all-inclusive chains)
Brand loyalty: Sandals Select rewards program for frequent guests
considerations: One of the more expensive options ($400–$700/night)
Not lifestyle-oriented — couples-focused romantic resort only
Some guests report inconsistent food quality vs. premium price
Can feel less personal than smaller boutique properties
High season (Dec–Apr) books up far in advance

reviews.name: Melanie S
reviews.text: Our first time to Sandals Negril and it did not disappoint. About 1.5 hour transfer from Montego Bay Airport. Quick and easy check in. Stayed in Paradise Beachfront Walkout room — very quiet (other than the usual sounds from Tree Frogs at night). Rooms cleaned and the fridge re-stocked daily. A smaller number of restaurants than some of the Sandals resorts but never had a problem getting reservations. The Sundowner was my favourite (Phillip was very helpful and professional), and my husband's favourite was Brava. Sileta and Terry Ann in the Bayside welcomed us with huge smiles each morning at breakfast. Willis at the Piano Bar was entertaining and remembered how we liked our drinks. There was regular beach service for drink top ups. Shout out to Janel who came by and chatted to us each day. Entertainment was good and didn't go on too late into the night. In all, we would recommend this resort to anyone wanting a relaxing time to do as much or as little as you wish. Small, colonial, with the calmest sea we have ever come across. We will return in the future.

response.text: Thank you for taking the time to share such a wonderful review of your recent stay at Sandals Negril. We are truly delighted to hear that your first visit exceeded expectations. Your kind recognition of Phillip, Sileta, Terry Ann, Willis, Janel, Keron, Vandam, Shadae, Anna-Kay, and Chavelle is sincerely appreciated. We look forward to warmly welcoming you back again in the future.

reviews.name: Deborah O
reviews.text: My husband and I had a fantastic time, 8 wonderful nights in a Butler suite #7303. Our Butlers Floyd and Myron were very attentive to all our needs — making reservations for dining, keeping our room stocked and delivering yummy breakfast to our room daily, drinks from the bar, seating us at the beach and the pool. A special lady named Lois who works at the bar at Perla kept our drinks flowing and we have become great friends. Elaine in loyalty is the best! We hope to return to Negril and reunite with all these amazing people. This was one of our favorite vacations to date. A big thank you to all.

response.text: Thank you for sharing your wonderful feedback regarding your recent stay at Sandals Negril. We are thrilled to hear that you and your husband had such a fantastic vacation and enjoyed eight memorable nights with us in your Butler Suite. Your kind recognition of Floyd, Myron, Lois, and Elaine is truly appreciated. We truly look forward to welcoming you back to Negril again soon.

reviews.name: Trek19552274959
reviews.text: This was my third visit to Sandals Negril and it's been excellent every time. From the hosts in the airport to the welcoming staff in the front lobby to the drivers that get guests safely to and from the resort, we feel well taken care of each time. The air conditioning is top notch. Housekeeping was timely and respectful. We had the pleasure of participating in the 10:00 a.m. water aerobics class led by the very qualified Kevon — friendly, fit, and he brought positive vibes the whole time. If you want all day entertainment and energy, hang by the larger pool. The food was delicious. Something for everyone. There are some vegan options. My partner and I keep coming back because of the friendliness of the staff and their efforts to check in with you throughout the day. The resort has been an inclusive environment each time we've visited. We've seen repeat guests each year that say the same thing — Negril is one of the best locations. You'll be getting your money's worth.

response.text: Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review regarding your recent stay at Sandals Negril. We are truly honored that you continue to choose Sandals Negril for your vacations. We are especially pleased to hear that Kevon made such a positive impression. Thank you once again for your continued loyalty and support. We look forward to welcoming you back for many more memorable stays.

reviews.text: First let me say that Sandals Negril is beautiful and the gardening team is stellar. The water activities team is excellent, and everyone there is very friendly. The bartenders are fun and two of the restaurants are outstanding. Older folks will appreciate the fact that the resort is smaller than other Sandals properties. Unfortunately, the staff attention to detail is lacking. Items that are supposed to be in rooms are often missing. Property information has not been updated so checking the TV in your room may or may not be correct. Maid service lacks scheduling consistency. Service at several restaurants is painfully slow and food may arrive barely warm if not cold. Chefs at the Japanese restaurant fail to put on a show when cooking. The coffee shop is very small and if you are an early riser, you may wait 20-30 minutes for a cup of coffee. When you balance the good against the below standard you come up with an average rating.

response.text: Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback regarding your recent stay at Sandals Negril. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the beauty of the resort, our gardens, the water sports team, and the warm hospitality provided by many of our team members. We sincerely apologize that several aspects of your stay did not meet expectations. Your feedback has been shared with resort management for careful review and we hope to welcome you back in the future.

reviews.name: BeachLover-NE
reviews.text: We love Negril, and we love Jamaica, so we chose this location for our free week. We had butler service in a Sundowner penthouse. Our two butlers — Myron and Floyd — were outstanding. They didn't let us go more than an hour without a fresh drink every day. On the day of our snorkel tour, Floyd was waiting on the shore with two cocktails — no butler has ever done that for us. THIS is the kind of outstanding service that is expected. Vandame did a fantastic photo shoot for us. Food and drinks were great as always. Brava is our favorite. The beach was great (although very eroded from Hurricane Melissa — they've lost 15-20 feet of frontage easily). Staff were outstanding as usual. Just love the Jamaican people as they always have a ready smile. This is most likely the last Sandals vacation we'll take — the room we were in was almost $10k for a week and needed more love. For $10k a week, I expected more. Thanks for the memories, Sandals... we've enjoyed our time with you, but feel we need to move on to places that offer better value.

response.text: Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback and for the many years you have spent vacationing with Sandals Resorts International. We are pleased to know that your butlers, Myron and Floyd, delivered such attentive and memorable service. Your comments regarding the room condition have been carefully noted and shared for internal review. We appreciate the opportunity we have had to host your vacations and wish you all the very best in your future travels.

reviews.name: Edward B
reviews.text: We have returned from our 46th trip to Sandals Negril. We are Ambassadors and upon arrival we were welcomed as if it was our first time at a Sandals. We got out of the car and there was no one in the lobby. As Ambassadors we are supposed to have in-room check-in. Upon arrival to the room and for the first time there was no welcome home sign. We had to call a few times due to not being re-stocked with wine. We had no hot water one night — cold showers suck! No wifi on the beach by Longshore rooms and one day with no electricity. All this was referred to staff with no apologies. The hot tub was cold for a few days. The food was just ok and the pizza was horrible — mostly rubbery dough. In a positive note, Negril has one of the best staff in the chain. They are always smiling, happy and caring about the guests. We have known a lot of them for over 25 years. Service in the restaurants and bars was great!

response.text: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent stay and, most importantly, for your incredible loyalty over the years. Celebrating your 46th visit and Ambassador status is truly remarkable. We are genuinely sorry to hear that several aspects of your arrival and overall experience did not reflect the level of recognition and seamless service that you have come to expect. Your feedback has been carefully noted and will be shared with the relevant management teams for further review.

reviews.name: Kristal L
reviews.text: We stayed at Sandals Negril for our Jamaica trip and honestly had such an amazing experience. This was our second time in Jamaica, but our first time staying here, and we'd definitely come back. The resort was super clean, the rooms were nice, and the beach setup was great. We chose a ground floor room just steps from the beach and it was 100% worth it. Being able to walk right out to the sand every morning and seeing all the wildlife was so awesome. Huge thank you to Chevelle D. and Orlando, our butler, for taking such good care of us. They always went above and beyond the whole trip. Also want to mention Andrew, the photographer — he did such an amazing job and we are SO happy with our pictures. Another person who stood out was Anneika — she was so kind, helpful, and always had a smile on her face. She served us at our sunset dinner on the beach and did such a phenomenal job. Overall we had an amazing stay and completely understand why people come back here again and again.

response.text: Thank you for sharing such a thoughtful review of your stay at Sandals Negril. We are truly delighted to learn that your first visit with us surpassed your expectations. We sincerely appreciate your kind recognition of Chevelle D., Orlando, Andrew, and Anneika. Thank you once again for choosing us for your Jamaica getaway. We look forward to welcoming you back again in the future.

reviews.name: Tim C
reviews.text: We did a split stay between here and Dunns River and I must say that the Negril location is a different type of vibe — it is definitely dated a little bit but it gives you that island feel. They are doing a lot of renovations trying to bring it up to Sandals 2.0 and I think that it will be even nicer in the coming years. We did have an issue with Perla staff not wanting to come out from the back at 2:00 am despite being open. I reached out through the app and Lancelot the food and beverage Director personally came to the pool, introduced himself, and handled the situation and even gave us a nice anniversary dinner experience. It still far outweighs every all-inclusive that we have been to. When we were there there was sargassum and the floating rafts were quite dirty — I reached out through the app and within two hours they were out there cleaning them. If that tells you anything, it's that you should probably book with Sandals.

response.text: Thank you for taking the time to share such thoughtful feedback regarding your experience at Sandals Negril. We are delighted to hear that you appreciated the unique island charm and relaxed atmosphere. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience experienced during your late-night visit to Perla. We are pleased to know that Lancelot personally assisted in addressing your concerns and helped create a memorable anniversary dining experience for you both.
